28:["$","p","1",{"dangerouslySetInnerHTML":{"__html":"<strong>Boho</strong> (short for <em>bohemian</em>) is the design language of layered textures, organic materials, vintage finds, and a deliberate rejection of matching-set furniture. For a home office, boho delivers something most other aesthetics can't: a workspace that feels like a creative sanctuary rather than a corporate cubicle."}}]
29:["$","p","2",{"dangerouslySetInnerHTML":{"__html":"Three things distinguish a real boho home office from a generic one:"}}]
2a:["$","ul","3",{"children":[["$","li","0",{"dangerouslySetInnerHTML":{"__html":"<strong>Layered textures</strong> — woven rugs, macramé wall hangings, jute baskets, woven accent pillows, raw wood. Multiple textures stacked rather than smooth surfaces everywhere."}}],["$","li","1",{"dangerouslySetInnerHTML":{"__html":"<strong>Plants — lots of them</strong> — boho is the only aesthetic where 5-10 plants in a single room reads correct rather than cluttered. Trailing pothos, hanging spider plants, fiddle leaf figs, snake plants, succulents."}}],["$","li","2",{"dangerouslySetInnerHTML":{"__html":"<strong>Vintage and handmade pieces</strong> — at least one antique item, one handmade item, and one item from your travels (or that looks like it). Mass-produced \"boho\" decor sets read fake instantly."}}]]}]
2b:["$","p","4",{"dangerouslySetInnerHTML":{"__html":"Boho home office search volume on Pinterest has been climbing steadily — a 2026 saved-pin study showed boho workspaces in the top three saved aesthetics, alongside Japandi and mid-century modern."}}]

2e:["$","ul","7",{"children":[["$","li","0",{"dangerouslySetInnerHTML":{"__html":"<strong>Warm whites and creams</strong> as the base"}}],["$","li","1",{"dangerouslySetInnerHTML":{"__html":"<strong>Earth tones</strong> — terracotta, rust, ochre, sand, deep brown"}}],["$","li","2",{"dangerouslySetInnerHTML":{"__html":"<strong>Muted greens</strong> — olive, sage, eucalyptus"}}],["$","li","3",{"dangerouslySetInnerHTML":{"__html":"<strong>Burnt orange and dusty pink</strong> as accent saturated colors"}}],["$","li","4",{"dangerouslySetInnerHTML":{"__html":"<strong>Black</strong> sparingly — usually in a wrought iron piece or framed art"}}],["$","li","5",{"dangerouslySetInnerHTML":{"__html":"<strong>Brass and aged-metal hardware</strong> rather than chrome"}}]]}]

53:["$","h2","44",{"id":"common-mistakes","children":"Common Mistakes"}]
54:["$","ul","45",{"children":[["$","li","0",{"dangerouslySetInnerHTML":{"__html":"<strong>Buying a \"boho decor set\" off Amazon.</strong> Mass-produced matching boho pieces read instantly fake. Boho lives on mismatch."}}],["$","li","1",{"dangerouslySetInnerHTML":{"__html":"<strong>Plants in plastic pots.</strong> Use terracotta, ceramic, woven baskets, or stoneware. Plastic kills the look."}}],["$","li","2",{"dangerouslySetInnerHTML":{"__html":"<strong>Too much color.</strong> Boho is earth tones + ONE saturated accent (rust OR dusty pink OR olive — pick one). Multiple bright colors stop reading as boho and start reading as chaotic."}}],["$","li","3",{"dangerouslySetInnerHTML":{"__html":"<strong>Modern furniture with no texture.</strong> A sleek IKEA white desk doesn't become boho just by adding plants. The desk itself needs visible grain, vintage character, or natural finish."}}],["$","li","4",{"dangerouslySetInnerHTML":{"__html":"<strong>Forgetting the rug.</strong> Boho lives on layered textures, and a rug is the most impactful texture in the room. Skipping it leaves the aesthetic flat."}}]]}]
55:["$","h2","46",{"id":"common-mistakes-specific-to-plants","children":"Common Mistakes Specific to Plants"}]
56:["$","ul","47",{"children":[["$","li","0",{"dangerouslySetInnerHTML":{"__html":"<strong>Don't buy plants you can't keep alive.</strong> Sansevieria, pothos, ZZ plants, and snake plants are nearly indestructible. Calatheas and ferns will die in a week without specific care."}}],["$","li","1",{"dangerouslySetInnerHTML":{"__html":"<strong>One large statement plant beats 10 small struggling ones.</strong> A single 6-foot fiddle leaf or rubber plant in a beautiful terracotta pot creates more impact than 10 small succulents on a windowsill."}}],["$","li","2",{"dangerouslySetInnerHTML":{"__html":"<strong>Group plants in odd numbers.</strong> Three plants on a shelf reads designed; four reads symmetrical and boring."}}]]}]
57:["$","h2","48",{"id":"frequently-asked-questions","children":"Frequently Asked Questions"}]
58:["$","p","49",{"dangerouslySetInnerHTML":{"__html":"<strong>Is boho good for productivity?</strong>"}}]
59:["$","p","50",{"dangerouslySetInnerHTML":{"__html":"For some users, very much yes — the layered comfort and natural materials reduce the \"corporate cubicle\" feeling that drains creative work. For users who need stark minimalism to focus, boho can feel cluttered. Test for a week."}}]
5a:["$","p","51",{"dangerouslySetInnerHTML":{"__html":"<strong>How is boho different from \"cottagecore\"?</strong>"}}]
5b:["$","p","52",{"dangerouslySetInnerHTML":{"__html":"Boho leans more global/eclectic with travel-inspired pieces, vintage finds, and layered patterns. Cottagecore is more pastoral/European with floral patterns, antique milk glass, and rural charm. Significant overlap but different sources of inspiration."}}]
5c:["$","p","53",{"dangerouslySetInnerHTML":{"__html":"<strong>Can I do boho in a small apartment?</strong>"}}]
5d:["$","p","54",{"dangerouslySetInnerHTML":{"__html":"Beautifully — small spaces actually suit boho because the layered textures fill rooms naturally. See our <a href=\"/blog/small-home-office-ideas\" class=\"text-orange-600 dark:text-orange-400 hover:underline font-medium\">small home office ideas</a> for compact layouts. Just be careful with plant volume in low-light apartments."}}]
5e:["$","p","55",{"dangerouslySetInnerHTML":{"__html":"<strong>Where do I find authentic vintage pieces?</strong>"}}]
5f:["$","p","56",{"dangerouslySetInnerHTML":{"__html":"Estate sales (best prices), Facebook Marketplace (best bargains, requires patience), Chairish (curated vintage, premium prices), and local antique shops. Avoid generic Amazon \"vintage-look\" reproductions — they read fake."}}]
60:["$","p","57",{"dangerouslySetInnerHTML":{"__html":"<strong>Is boho still trendy in 2026?</strong>"}}]
61:["$","p","58",{"dangerouslySetInnerHTML":{"__html":"Yes — boho has been a steady top-five Pinterest aesthetic for over a decade now. Like Mid-Century Modern, it's transitioned from trend to permanent style. Pinterest searches for boho home office are up year-over-year."}}]
62:["$","p","59",{"dangerouslySetInnerHTML":{"__html":"<strong>What plants are best for a boho home office without much sunlight?</strong>"}}]
63:["$","p","60",{"dangerouslySetInnerHTML":{"__html":"Snake plant (Sansevieria), ZZ plant, pothos, philodendron, and cast iron plant tolerate low light and look the part. Avoid fiddle leaf figs and succulents in low-light rooms — they'll die. See our <a href=\"/blog/desk-plants-for-focus\" class=\"text-orange-600 dark:text-orange-400 hover:underline font-medium\">desk plants for focus guide</a> for picks."}}]
